summary: Iter 7: Validated the NEW HANDS-FREE CONTINUOUS scan feature. Injected navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia shim (canvas.captureStream) via add_init_script before goto; also route-intercepted /api/scan-frame with mocked 4-card responses to get deterministic locks (real vision recognition on a synthetic canvas was too noisy). All continuous/toggle/done behaviors verified end-to-end. Confidence-flag + history + no-share + no-overflow regressions still pass. Permission-denied path could not be exercised in the automation browser (see notes) but code path is correct on code review.

continuous_auto_capture.3s cadence: PASS — observed 13 scan-frame requests in ~40s (~3.1s spacing) with 200 responses
continuous_auto_capture.confirmed reaches 4/4: PASS — 'scan-confirmed' text becomes '4 of 4 cards confirmed', all 4 progress segments turn emerald

same_hand_dedupe.10s of continuous captures of same hand: PASS — hands count stays at 1 (1→1); dedupe by sorted cardId signature works

hand_switch_relogs.changing mocked response to a new 4-card: PASS — new lock fires ('Scored: Q♠ J♥ 9♦ 8♣'), hands count 1→2

permission_denied.reason: The Playwright browser's navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia could be overridden to RETURN a stream (used successfully in all other tests), but attempts to override it to THROW NotAllowedError did not take effect (verification getUserMedia({video:true}) returned 'ok' instead of throwing). This appears to be a Chromium/Playwright quirk with re-overriding mediaDevices after it has been previously replaced.
permission_denied.code_review: PASS — CameraCapture.jsx catches e.name==='NotAllowedError' and renders 'Camera permission denied. Allow camera access and try again.' plus data-testid=camera-retry-btn. Logic is correct.

regression_upload_flag.route-intercept /api/recognize-cards wit: PASS — flagged-notice reads '2 cards the scanner wasn\'t sure about'; data-flagged=[false,true,true,false] on card-trigger-1..4

critical_code_review_comments: CameraCapture.jsx loop() correctly gates capture on scanningRef.current (paused toggle stops NEW captures immediately after next 500ms tick). Good separation of refs vs state.
Dedupe key uses sorted cardIds join — order-invariant, correct.
lastLockedRef is reset in start() so a fresh open re-scores even the same hand next session — matches spec.

MINOR RACE (not observed as failure): if user clicks Done while an in-flight scanFrame() is pending, activeRef.current=false but the response still resolves and calls setConfirmed/setLastHand (Component may be about to unmount). React may warn about state updates on unmounted component in strict mode. Consider guarding with `if (!activeRef.current) return;` after the await in loop().

MINOR: on re-open after Done, if a previous loop iteration was mid-sleep(3000) when activeRef flipped to false, it will exit correctly (while(activeRef.current) is checked at top of each iter), but a new loop instance starts from start(). Fine, but two independent loops could briefly coexist if timing is unlucky. Consider a generation counter to fully invalidate old loops.

Evaluator.jsx toast.error on evaluate failure uses err?.response?.data?.detail directly. For 422 responses (list of pydantic error objects), sonner tries to render an object and CRASHES the whole page (observed during a mocked scan-frame test that returned rank 'T' — a real /api/scan-frame normalises T→10 server-side, so this doesn't manifest in prod, but recommend stringifying/guarding detail in toast to prevent full-page crash on any future 422).
CameraCapture Dialog has no explicit ARIA description prop, but DialogDescription is provided — good.
Auto-scan default ON matches spec; toggle label + 'Paused'/'Capturing every 3s' subtext is clear UX.
scan-progress segments animate cleanly; scan-last-hand uses SUIT_MAP symbols consistently.
action_items: (Low-priority hardening) In Evaluator.jsx runEvaluate catch: coerce err.response.data.detail to string before passing to toast.error to prevent 'Objects are not valid as a React child' crashes on 422s.
(Optional) Guard state updates in CameraCapture loop() with activeRef check after each await to silence potential unmount warnings.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of new continuous-scan scenarios verified; 1 regression path (permission denied) verified only by code review

seed_data_creation: Wiped /api/hands (DELETE) at start of each test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To reliably test the hands-free continuous loop in Playwright: (1) add_init_script that overrides navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia to return canvas.captureStream(15), (2) intercept /api/scan-frame with page.route to return deterministic 4-card JSON — the vision model on a synthetic canvas is too noisy to reliably return 4 cards. GET /api/hands returns {hands:[...]}, not a bare list — extract .hands when counting. Permission-denied path could not be triggered in Chromium after overriding mediaDevices once; consider using Playwright's context.grant_permissions([]) or launching a fresh context with camera permission explicitly denied for that specific test.
